note: Level 1's missions as the player sees them: a title, then one objective at a time (world/missions.gd, shown by ui/objective.gd). A step is done when its event happens (world/level_story.gd sends them): lift, puff, chop:<kind>, weapon:<id>, stage:<route stage id>, door_open, inside. An event that finishes a later step skips ahead. If the player makes no progress for a while, the hint is said aloud.

steps.text: Lift the pebble the ants couldn't move
hint: That pebble, kid. Walk up to it and lift it. Go on.

steps.text: Follow the ants to their camp by the pencil
hint: The camp's by the big yellow pencil. Follow me, kid.

steps.text: Follow them east to their old rest stop in the crisp packet
hint: East, to the shiny crisp packet. Our rest stop. Stay close.

steps.text: Take the axe the ants give you
Escape: climb to the top of your school bag
hint: Up the bag, kid. The hunters can't climb that.

steps.text: Grab a seed puff and glide down
hint: The fluffy seeds up here. Grab one and jump. Trust me.

steps.text: Make for the dandelion in the Blade Forest
hint: The big yellow flower. Can't miss it. Well, you might.

steps.text: Climb the daisy stair in the Flower Bed
hint: West, to the flowers. Hop up the daisy heads.

steps.text: Find the old door between the apple tree's roots
hint: The apple tree, kid. There's a door in its roots. Follow the gold.
East, past the web. Don't touch it.

steps.text: Climb up to the Capstone lookout
hint: The bottle cap, kid. Best view in the garden.
The gate! The red earth, east! Move!

steps.text: Run back to Root Hall before dark
hint: Back to the apple tree. The old door. Run!
Lean on it, kid. Hold E and push.
